measurement: source-read on 2026-11-08, no live run: this file carries what was read, not what was measured
subject: the authenticated `game_endgame` operation from HTTP ingress to the `gameended` projection

entryChain.auth: loopback http origin, exact Origin header, exact JSON content type, session cookie bearer token and x-csrf-token (host/src/composed-reference-game-browser.ts:947-971); a request that fails any of them answers 401 unauthorized (:1894)

entryChain.reading: the admission names the exact browser session and the exact operation (`game_endgame`) and is consumed synchronously before the coordinator runs

entryChain.step: the sink the desktop composition binds
entryChain.reading: the route is mounted only when the sink declares endgameGame; a composition that does not answers 404 not_found (:1882-1887)

guards in order: endgameSettled replay (:2177 -> projected gameended again), idempotency conflict (:2180-2187), isClosing (:2189), expectedAttachmentGeneration (:2190), exactOwner (:2192-2193 -> stardew_game_endgame_unavailable)

teardownAttachment -> containPlayerHost(owner) (:2209-2211) -> containAiClient(owner) when the AI role launched (:2213-2216) -> containedRuntimeTeardown.settle(owner) (:2221) -> endgameSettled = true (:2222) -> Object.freeze({ apiVersion: 1, status: "gameended" }) (:2224)

entryChain.step: where the teardown object comes from
entryChain.reading: the containment and the settle are answered by a ContainedGameRuntimePlatform built over one DesktopGuardianSession; without a collaborator the factory installs a playerHostLaunch that throws stardew_player_host_launch_runtime_unavailable (:3545-3563)

entryChain.step: where the Guardian session comes from
entryChain.reading: the session is a named-pipe client for \\.\pipe\GameBuddy.HostGuardian.<bootstrapId> that speaks hello/arm/launch/contain/recovery; it is constructed only inside the desktop bootstrap from the bootstrap frame's guardian capability

projectionFacts.gameendedIsAResultNotAState: `gameended` exists in exactly one schema, GameEndgameResultV1 (host/src/game-browser-contract/index.ts:504-513), the redacted outcome of the operation. The state projection (host/src/game-browser/game-browser-state-provider.ts:89-121) has no `gameended` member: it reports instance status, attachment status and actionAuthority, so the browser reads the end of the game through those fields, not through a `gameended` state value.
projectionFacts.mintedOnlyAfterSettle: the literal is produced at stardew-production-lifecycle-coordinator.internal.ts:2224, after settle(owner) resolved; every other exit throws and is projected as a problem code (:595-601 in composed-reference-game-browser.ts)

prerequisiteMatrix.prerequisite: loopback HTTP ingress with real bootstrap token, session cookie, CSRF and exact Origin
prerequisiteMatrix.why: all of it is JavaScript in the product's own handler (host/src/composed-reference-game-browser.ts:197-217, :881-981); a harness can bootstrap one session and send the real headers

prerequisiteMatrix.prerequisite: a durable semantic authority and a registered Stardew installation
prerequisiteMatrix.why: createSharedSemanticProductionAuthorityFromDeploymentManifest + the discovery/confirm route (host/src/composed-reference-game-browser.ts:911-912, coordinator :2933) over the real install; not exercised by this reading

prerequisiteMatrix.prerequisite: a real Player Host launch through the contained runtime
prerequisiteMatrix.why: runPlayerHostLaunch (:1424-1457) goes through playerHostLaunch, which is built only from runtimeLaunchPlayerHost (:3545-3553); without it nothing sets playerHostLaunchThroughRuntime (:1437), so endgame would contain no role at all

prerequisiteMatrix.prerequisite: the Guardian endpoint that answers arm_attempt / launch_role / contain_role for the private session
prerequisiteMatrix.why: the server side of \\.\pipe\GameBuddy.HostGuardian.<bootstrapId> exists only in the native Desktop supervisor (desktop/GameBuddy.Desktop, host/native/windows-bootstrap-guardian/GuardianProtocol.cs, GuardianPrivateLaunchIngress.cs), which injects the one token key the Host's arm frame deliberately omits; the repository's own desktop gate launcher serves hello and then destroys the socket on any arm/launch/contain frame (tools/desktop-composition-launch.mjs:507, :542-545), so even a harness that mints a full desktop composition cannot drive the game surface's containment

endgame never attaches: teardownAttachment returns immediately when no facade, lease or generation exists (stardew-production-lifecycle-coordinator.internal.ts:2056-2061), and the AI role is contained only when aiClientLaunchThroughRuntime is set (:1437, :2213)
no route on the endgame path reads a provider, a credential, or a model; the previous notProven wording named it as the blocker and reading the chain does not support that

notProven: the `gameended` projection: the authenticated `game_endgame` operation is reachable over real HTTP ingress with no AI provider credential, but its result is minted only after containedRuntimeTeardown.settle(owner), and that teardown is built over a DesktopGuardianSession whose Guardian endpoint exists only in the native Desktop supervisor; reading 6 proves the containment half (`contain_role player_host` over the public guardian control channel), not the projection

the desktop/browser read of that outcome: the state projection has no `gameended` member, so what a browser reads after an endgame is instance status plus actionAuthority, and no live run has yet held a session that could reach the operation
